name: finance.fibrous/fibx
title: FibX
description: Swap, transfer, track a portfolio and use Aave V3 on Base, Citrea, HyperEVM and Monad.

packageArguments.description: Starts the MCP server over stdio.

environmentVariables.name: FIBX_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Custom fibx-server URL for Privy wallet operations. Optional; only needed when self-hosting the backend.

environmentVariables.name: FIBX_SESSION_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Encryption key for the local session file. Optional; auto-generated per machine when unset.
